_comment: The only load root is `main.js` + `page-a.js`, and requests count only on it, so no merge can save a request on a subgroup it does not download. `lib-c` is loaded by `page-b`, which imports `page-c` statically, and by `page-c`; the group leaves it to default chunking, which puts it in the chunk of `page-c`, instead of a `lib~page-b~page-c` chunk of its own. `lib-shared`, which the root downloads, stays in the group.
